reasoning: On the season so far the Knicks are the stronger team; with home court the Knicks start about 7 points better, in a game of about 227 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Heat.
The mental side leans about 0 points towards the Heat (confidence).
Bottom line: the Knicks win 59 times in 100, by about 4; most games like this end between 199 and 247 total points.

analyst.text: This is win-or-go-home for New York: a loss eliminates the Knicks from the Cup, while a Miami win takes East Group B. The Knicks bring a six-game winning streak; Miami's seven-game run just ended. Giannis Antetokounmpo (groin) and Andrew Wiggins (ankle) are both probable for the Heat, and OG Anunoby is still out for New York. Stakes and form lean New York at home.
